title.narrative: Solomon Islands Democratic Governance and Electoral Assistance Project

description.narrative: The Solomon Islands Democratic Governance and Electoral Assistance Project (2026–2029) supports the Government of Solomon Islands and the Solomon Islands Elections Commission (SIEC) in strengthening the integrity, inclusiveness, and effectiveness of the electoral cycle leading to the 2028 joint national, provincial, and local elections. Building on the successful conduct of the 2024 Joint Elections and informed by the 2025 UN Electoral Needs Assessment Mission and the final evaluation of the SEC
independent political entity

title.narrative: Support to the development of a strategic plan for ORPP completed

description.narrative: This indicator measures the completion of project support to the Office of the Registrar of Political Parties (ORPP) in developing a comprehensive strategic plan. The strategic plan will provide a clear framework to guide ORPP’s mandate, priorities, and operations, including the regulation of political parties, compliance oversight, and institutional strengthening. Project support includes technical assistance, consultations with relevant stakeholders, facilitation of planning workshops, and support to drafting, validation, and finalization of the strategic plan. Completion of this indicator signifies that the strategic plan has been formally developed, validated, and endorsed, enabling ORPP to operate more effectively, transparently, and sustainably in carrying out its functions.

title.narrative: Concrete measures towards CRVS & ID system (Gov decisions, resolutions etc).

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of concrete government-endorsed measures adopted to advance the integration and strengthening of the Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (CRVS) system and the national identification system, including official decisions, resolutions, or policy directions.

title.narrative: Number of coordination and improvement mechanisms

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of coordination and institutional improvement mechanisms established to enhance collaboration, efficiency, and service delivery between SIEC headquarters and provincial electoral offices.

title.narrative: Number of amendments to the law passed

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of legislative amendments to the electoral legal framework that are formally enacted by the competent authority. It reflects progress in strengthening and modernizing the legal and regulatory environment governing the electoral cycle, based on identified reform priorities.

title.narrative: Number of measures adopted in terms of elections with integrity

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of measures adopted to strengthen electoral integrity through the meaningful engagement of youth and persons with disabilities, including guidelines, codes of conduct, procedural measures, or institutional practices.

title.narrative: Number of measures adopted towards NID & CRVS

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of operational or institutional measures adopted by relevant authorities to advance the implementation and integration of national identification (NID) and CRVS systems.

title.narrative: Number of participants in thematic events

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of participants attending thematic events supported by the project that focus on youth and persons with disabilities (PWDs), aimed at promoting inclusive participation and strengthening electoral integrity.

title.narrative: Number of officials trained

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of provincial electoral officials trained to strengthen professional capacity, technical competence, and service delivery in support of electoral administration at the sub-national level.

title.narrative: Number of studies, reports and research papers

description.narrative: This indicator tracks the number of analytical studies, technical reports, and research papers produced to inform evidence-based decision-making on CRVS and national identification system reform and integration.

title.narrative: Number of improvements towards PWDs accessibility

description.narrative: This indicator tracks the number of concrete improvements supported by the project to enhance accessibility for persons with disabilities (PWDs) within electoral processes, including physical access, information accessibility, or procedural adjustments.

title.narrative: Number of provincial office sites identified and cleared

description.narrative: This indicator tracks the number of provincial office sites that are identified, assessed, and cleared for the establishment of SIEC provincial offices in accordance with technical, administrative, and regulatory requirements.

title.narrative: Number of thematic workshops and events

description.narrative: This indicator tracks the number of thematic workshops, forums, and public events organised to promote women’s political participation, leadership, and representation in electoral and governance processes.

title.narrative: Number of voter and civic education activities initiated

description.narrative: This indicator tracks the number of voter and civic education activities initiated by provincial electoral offices to enhance voter awareness, participation, and trust in electoral processes.

title.narrative: Support in the conduct of a civic education campaign completed (ORPP)

description.narrative: This indicator measures the completion of project support to the Office of the Registrar of Political Parties (ORPP) in conducting civic education campaigns. These campaigns aim to increase public awareness and understanding of the role of political parties, the legal framework governing their operations, and citizens’ rights and responsibilities in relation to political participation.

title.narrative: Number of meetings of the task force/committee

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of formal meetings of the CRVS and national identification task force or committee convened to coordinate stakeholders, guide technical work, and oversee implementation of agreed measures.

title.narrative: Number of plans and technical assessment

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of strategic plans and technical assessments developed to support the establishment of Solomon Islands Electoral Commission (SIEC) provincial offices, including feasibility assessments, infrastructure planning, and operational requirements.

title.narrative: Number of Voters Education Campaign

description.narrative: This indicator measures the total number of voter education campaigns implemented during the project period to enhance voter awareness, knowledge, and participation in electoral processes. Voter education campaigns include nationwide or targeted outreach activities such as community awareness sessions, media campaigns, civic education programmes, and dissemination of voter information materials, with particular attention to inclusiveness and accessibility. The indicator is cumulative and captures voter education campaigns conducted in preparation for general elections and by-elections supported by the project. Progress under this indicator reflects strengthened voter awareness, informed participation, and improved transparency of the electoral process.

title.narrative: Number of women participating in the Outstanding Women initiatives

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of women who participate in the Outstanding Women initiatives supported by the project, aimed at strengthening women’s leadership, political participation, and capacity to engage in electoral and political processes.

title.narrative: Number of candidates registered

description.narrative: This indicator measures the total number of eligible candidates formally registered to contest national and sub-national elections during the project period, in accordance with the legal and procedural requirements established by the Solomon Islands Electoral Commission (SIEC). The indicator reflects the effectiveness of electoral administration processes related to candidate nomination, registration, and verification.

title.narrative: Task force technical assessments and legal drafts

description.narrative: This indicator tracks the number of technical assessments, legal analyses, and draft legal instruments produced by the electoral reform task force to inform evidence-based amendments to the legal and regulatory framework.

title.narrative: Number of trained electoral officials

description.narrative: This indicator measures the total number of electoral officials who have successfully completed training programmes supported by the project, in line with the operational and legal requirements of the Solomon Islands Electoral Commission (SIEC). Training covers key aspects of electoral administration, including voter registration, polling and counting procedures, results management, electoral integrity, and adherence to electoral laws and codes of conduct. The indicator is cumulative and captures trained officials across all electoral events supported during the project period, including general elections and by-elections. Progress under this indicator reflects strengthened institutional capacity, improved professionalism, and enhanced effectiveness of Electoral Management Bodies in delivering credible, transparent, and inclusive electoral processes.

title.narrative: Number of women elected in provincial government

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of women elected to provincial government positions, reflecting progress toward increased women’s political representation at sub-national levels.

title.narrative: Advocacy to increase the number of women elected in parliament

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of advocacy initiatives supported by the project that aim to increase the number of women elected to parliament, including campaigns, policy dialogue, stakeholder engagement, and public awareness activities.

title.narrative: Number of electoral materials procured (voting kits and ballot boxes)

description.narrative: This indicator measures the total number of essential electoral materials procured and made available to support the effective conduct of electoral processes in the Solomon Islands. Electoral materials include, but are not limited to, voting kits, ballot boxes, polling stationery, and other logistics required for voter registration, polling, counting, and results management.

title.narrative: Number of Lesson Learned Exercises

description.narrative: This indicator measures the total number of structured lessons learned exercises conducted during the project period to capture, document, and apply key experiences, challenges, and good practices related to the delivery of electoral assistance. Lessons learned exercises include after-action reviews, post-election evaluations, debriefings, and reflection workshops involving Electoral Management Bodies and relevant stakeholders.
